ov: إبنزر (الإنجليزية: Ebenezer) هو فلم فنتازيا أمريكي قادم، أخرجه تي ويست، وكتب سيناريوه ناثانيال هالبيرن، استنادًا إلى رواية ترنيمة عيد الميلاد الصادرة عام 1843 للكاتب تشارلز ديكنز. ويؤدي أدوار البطولة جوني ديب وروبرت غرينت وأندريا رايزبورو وسام كلافلن وديزي ريدلي وآرثر كونتي وإيلي بامبر وتشارلي ميرفي وهنري لويد هيوز وتراميل تيلمان وإيان ماكيلين. من المقرر أن تطرح باراماونت بيكتشرز الفلم في دور العرض الأمريكية في 13 نوفمبر 2026.
plotEn:
On Christmas Eve 1836, in Victorian-era London, moneylender Ebenezer Scrooge works with his business partner, Jacob Marley, and their clerk, Bob Cratchit. Marley suddenly collapses and dies in the office, with Scrooge attending his funeral as the sole mourner and stealing Marley's pocket watch.
Seven years later, a disillusioned and withdrawn Scrooge continues to work with Bob. Scrooge is visited by his nephew, Fred, who invites him to dine with him and his wife Clara. He refuses, and then rudely turns away two men who ask him for a donation to feed the poor, hinting that their charity is a confidence trick and decrying Christmas itself as a farce. At the end of the workday, Bob asks Scrooge if he can take Christmas off with pay. Scrooge begrudgingly allows it, but only if Bob arrives early the next day. When Scrooge walks home, he sees his door knocker has taken the form of Marley's face.
As Scrooge prepares for bed, he hears the sound of chains dragging. Marley's tortured ghost appears, doomed to wander the earth without rest or peace. Marley confronts Scrooge, warning him that he will be visited by three spirits who will try to reform Scrooge lest  he share Marley's fate in death.
